_comment: A source archive whose package.json declares a ranged dependency and no `scripts`, and commits no lock. In a SOURCE submission a package.json is always a build manifest - only an XPI-only submission may use one to declare vendored libraries - so the absent `scripts` block buys nothing and sca-lock-file-missing rejects it. xpi-package-unpinned stays silent: it is sca:false, because a range is legitimate here and the lock is what must pin it. sca-lock-file-invalid has no lock to read. The shipped background.js is packed so the archive is not redundant.
